articles.title: 3 bridges in Cagayan town remain flooded due to shear line rains
articles.description: TUGUEGARAO CITY — Three overflow bridges in Baggao, Cagayan remained closed to motorists on Monday after rains brought by the shear line caused the Cagayan River and its tributaries to swell. The Baggao Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office reported that the Bagunot, Mosimoc, and Taytay-San Isidro overflow bridges were impassable due to flooding. Six other bridges—Camata, Dabbac Grande-Asinga Via, Taguntungan, Annayatan, Mocag, and C. Versoza—remained passable as water levels in nearby rivers began to recede. 12-hour power outage set in Ilocos Sur's 2nd District on Nov. 26
articles.description: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — The entire 2nd District of Ilocos Sur, except the municipalities of Sugpon, Cervantes, and Quirino, will experience a 12-hour scheduled power interruption on Thursday, Nov. 26, to allow for annual preventive maintenance and testing by the National Grid Corporation of the Philippines (NGCP). In an advisory on Monday, the Ilocos Sur Electric Cooperative (ISECO)-Candon said the interruption will run from 6:30 a.m. to 6:30 p.m. The maintenance work will cover the 115-kilovolt (kV), 100-megavolt-ampere (MVA) Transformer No. 1 and its associated lines and equipment at the NGCP San Esteban Substation. articles.title: EU officials reject Cop31 deal as it 'doesn't speak to reality of the climate crisis' – video
articles.description: The Cop31 climate talks fell into disarray as the EU, UK and allies in the developing world rejected what they called an unacceptable deal on the future of the climate. Ireland's climate minister, Darragh O'Brien, said the EU could not support the proposed deal, in part because it made no mention of fossil fuels. The president of the negotiations, Australia's Chris Bowen, called the failure 'very disappointing', saying that a lot of good work had been done but 'many parties who were people of good faith had very strong red lines on a couple of key issues, and despite many, many attempts … those red lines on behalf of different parties were just not able to be met.'
